test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In which district of Gujarat is the Modhera dance festival organised by the Government of Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mehsana.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The Modhera dance festival is organized by the Government of Gujarat in the Mehsana district of Gujarat.**
 
• The festival is held annually in the month of January at the** Sun Temple in Modhera, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.**
 
• The festival showcases various classical dance forms of India such as** Kathak, Bharatnatyam, Kuchipudi, and Odissi.**
 
• The festival also includes a handicraft fair and a food festival,** offering a glimpse of the rich cultural heritage and cuisine of Gujarat.**
 
• The Sun Temple at Modhera is an ancient Hindu temple dedicated to the Sun God and is known for its unique architecture and intricate carvings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amreli** is a district in the Saurashtra region of Gujarat known for its **wildlife sanctuary and historical monuments.**
 
• **Bharuch** is a district in the southern part of Gujarat known for its** industrial development and religious sites.**
 
• **Dang is a district **in the eastern part of Gujarat known for its** tribal culture and natural beauty. It is also home to the Saputara Hill Station.**
 
• ** Mehsana **is a district in the northern part of Gujarat known for its** historical significance, agricultural produce, and industrial development. It is also home to the famous Modhera Sun Temple.**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 4 - Mehsana.
